info.name: RealityOS API
info.description: Two independent folders: Server requests (https://realityos.luxisoft.com) and Localhost requests (http://localhost:8080). All variables, public demo credentials and demo workspace IDs are included; environments are optional. Click Send on a protected request: sign-in and token renewal run automatically. Run 00 Quick start to check the full access sequence. The demo role is query-only in an empty test workspace; use your own authorized account for writes and real data. Enable the local demo once with scripts/local/Enable-PostmanDemo.ps1. Session tokens are never included in the published file.
